name: Image
description: Generate an image via the Mac host-mcp image tool (gpt/grok) and relay it to the chat.

hostMcpToken.description: Bearer token for host-mcp (wired via `openclaw config set`, not committed).

defaultProvider.description: Default image provider when --provider is omitted (default gpt).

napcatHttpUrl.description: NapCat OneBot HTTP base for image egress, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3010 (defaults to channels.onebot.httpUrl).

napcatToken.description: NapCat access token for egress (defaults to channels.onebot.accessToken).
